title: My conclusion about MallWorld after some studies

classification.theory_summary: Proposes MallWorld dreams arise from: anxiety/choice overload in malls, childhood/adolescent memory imprinting, social-connection needs (crowds), full vs empty environments, nostalgia (90s/2000s; vaporwave/mallsoft/liminal/AI imagery), and transition/change symbolism (movement, bus stations). Also suggests discussion/subreddit increases frequency via salience.
classification.skip_reason: No first-person dream narrative; post is explanatory/theoretical and references others' dreams in general terms.

meta.author_theory: MallWorld dreams explained by anxiety/choice overload, childhood memory imprinting, social-connection needs, full/empty environment symbolism, nostalgia (incl. vaporwave/mallsoft/liminal/AI imagery), and transition/change themes; salience from discussing topic may increase frequency.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains no specific dream scene(s). Only generalized descriptors of commonly reported MallWorld settings (e.g., crowded/empty malls, schools, bus stations) without concrete, situated phenomenology (lighting, layout, sequence, entities, actions).
